holes_found.description: RESIDUAL of the c5 hole0 seam in the closing sentence of detail_verdict_text. The main post-hoc paragraph was correctly repaired (post-hoc now attaches to the phenomenon, and explicitly concedes the dome number does not reproduce the textbook value). But the final sentence still reads: "No legitimate-novelty carve-out applies: the value is not obscure and the derivation (where one is offered at all) is algebraically equivalent to a standard-model derivation." For WIN-021 specifically this re-imports the exact assumption the c5 fix removed — that the dome’s value IS the standard value. Our own evidence says the dome’s number is dimensionally wrong and 37% off, i.e. NOT the standard value, and there is NO dome derivation (derives_from_dome=false). A dome defender can reopen the you-can’t-have-it-both-ways seam on this sentence alone: ‘You call my value not-obscure and my derivation algebraically-equivalent-to-the-standard-model — then it IS the standard value, and your 37%-mismatch/units critique collapses.’ The hedge ‘(where one is offered at all)’ only partially blunts it. This is generic post-hoc-carve-out boilerplate that fits value-MATCHING WINs (WIN-001/033/050/051) but is a poor fit for the one non-matching outlier.
holes_found.recommendation: Reword or drop the trailing sentence for this WIN. Suggested: "No legitimate-novelty carve-out applies: axial precession is a millennia-old textbook phenomenon, so labeling precession-exists a prediction adds nothing — and the dome offers no derivation from its geometry that would make 4.87e-12 rad/s^2 a novel result (it neither matches the standard value nor is derived from dome parameters)." Remove the "value is not obscure ... algebraically equivalent to a standard-model derivation" phrasing, which silently assumes value-match.

stronger_arguments.description: Lead the verdict with the unit-agnostic kill: the dome’s number is wrong under EVERY reading — as an acceleration it is ~12.7 orders too large (2e7/yr runaway); as a velocity it is 37% low and implies a ~40,883-yr period matching nothing (not the 25,772-yr cycle). ‘There is no unit under which this number is correct’ is cleaner than any post-hoc framing and sidesteps the residual seam entirely.

kernel_of_truth.description: The dome is right that axial precession is a real, well-quantified phenomenon with a ~25,772-year cycle and a rate near 50 arcsec/yr (WIN-021 detail_evidence; IAU 2006 P03, DOI 10.1051/0004-6361:20031539). A tau=I*alpha gyroscopic framing of precession is legitimate physics — precession genuinely arises from luni-solar torque on the equatorial bulge.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Being right that precession exists does not make 4.87e-12 rad/s^2 correct or predicted. The number is dimensionally wrong (rad/s^2 for a rate) and, corrected to rad/s, 37% below the measured 7.73e-12 rad/s (WIN-021 detail_evidence; verified in this review quantitative_verification). No derivation from dome geometry (code_analysis_tags.derives_from_dome=false; raw-text/02-wins.txt:106 carries no math) and no automation checks it (monitoring=none). Right physics category, wrong number and wrong units — the Misleading pattern.

advocate_mode.preemptive_recommendation: Close the trailing sentence per holes_found[0]. Once the boilerplate stops asserting value-match/standard-equivalence for this outlier WIN, the you-can’t-have-it-both-ways defense has no remaining textual foothold.

quantitative_verification.computations: python3: omega=50.2881*(pi/648000)/(365.25*86400)=7.7257e-12 rad/s (text 7.73e-12 OK). period=2pi/omega=25,769 yr (text 25,772 OK). mismatch=(omega-4.87e-12)/omega=37.0% (text 37% OK). accel=2*(pi/648000)/(100*yr_s)^2=9.74e-25 rad/s^2 (text ~1e-24 OK). log10(4.87e-12/9.74e-25)=12.70 (text twelve OK). runaway=4.87e-12*yr_s/omega=1.99e7 (text ~2e7 OK). dome-as-velocity period=2pi/4.87e-12/yr_s=40,883 yr (confirms the number matches no cycle, incl. 25,772 yr). All current-text numbers verify.
quantitative_verification.discrepancies: None. Every number in the current WIN-021 text verifies; the 40,883-yr computation corroborates that the c5 hole1 fix (removing the 25,772-yr attribution to the dome) was correct.
